Comment_glosser: a loan from Arabic (Afro-Asiatic) or code-switching. Historically, 20 in Semitic was formed as 10 with a dual marker and the other decades as 3, 4 etc. with a plural marker (Brockelmann 1916: 119). However, the suffixes have been analogically regularized leading to the synchronically confusing system where 20 vs. other decades seem to be formed with the same suffix but different operations
